_: What each routed repository's merge path requires, and which of those checks this
host's identity gate reproduces.
`config/onevcs.rules.yml` names the gate `onevcs` runs before it publishes. That
gate is not the merge path: for every remote-publishing identity here the merge is
decided by GitHub's required status checks, and a gate that runs less than they do
verifies a branch that cannot merge. That is not hypothetical — a lifecycle branch
on `nick-derobertis-site` passed its gate, published as PR #77, and was refused by
the required `llmlint` check the gate never ran.
So each identity's required checks are recorded here against the command this
host's gate runs for them. A check under `gate_runs` names a command the resolved
gate must contain; a check under `not_run` names why nothing here runs it, and is
reported by `just repos --audit-gate-coverage` as able to refuse the merge anyway.
Nothing is claimed by omission: a required check in neither map is a declaration
error, and the audit treats an identity it does not know at all as uncovered.
Two tests keep this honest. `test_every_declared_gate_command_is_in_the_rule_gate`
runs offline against the gate `onevcs` resolves, so a rule edited back to a bare
`check` fails the suite rather than a pull request.
`test_the_declared_required_checks_match_each_repositorys_branch_protection` asks
GitHub what is really required, so a check added, renamed, or made required after
this file was written is found here rather than by a blocked change request.
Add an identity together with its rule: `just repos-apply` refuses a checkout no
rule names, and the suite refuses a rule this file does not classify.

reasons.other-os: runs on an operating system this host does not have, so no gate here can stand in for it
reasons.pull-request: judges the pull request itself (its title, or its commits), which does not exist until the branch is pushed
reasons.published-artifact: installs, packages, or publishes a release artifact rather than judging the working tree
reasons.visual-baseline: captures screenshots in CI's pinned container and classifies them against a hosted baseline this host cannot reproduce
reasons.paid-turn: spends a real agent turn against a paid provider, which a gate on every dispatch would bill for repeatedly
reasons.network-advisory: resolves a network-fetched advisory database whose contents change independently of the branch, so a verdict here is not a property of the change
reasons.ci-selection: a CI job that only selects which lanes run and carries no verdict about the tree
reasons.judged-remotely: this host's identity gate does not run it; it is judged remotely and can refuse the merge

github.com/nickderobertis/ai-orchestrato.note: The one local-direct identity: it opens no pull request, so no required check exists to overturn its pre-push gate.

github.com/nickderobertis/llmlint.note: Runs an llmlint job on every pull request but has never required it, so this gate deliberately does not.

github.com/nickderobertis/oneharness.note: Its `gate` recipe already carries `deps-check` and the judged tier, so one command answers three required checks.

github.com/nickderobertis/screencomp.note: Runs an llmlint job on every pull request but has never required it, so this gate deliberately does not.
